## Abstract

For scRNAseq datasets (Breast and bladder), we want to investigate expression of genes and signatures in whole tumor clusters and in fibroblast clusters.

We need:
1. Image of whole tumor clusters with identification assigned
2. Image of fibroblast clusters assigned
3. Map of expression in both types of data (whole tumor and fibroblasts) for indicated genes and signatures
4. Expression matrix (average) so we can generate a heatmap or graph (gene and signatures).
5. For the BLCA dataset that we have normal and cancer tissue, expression matrix for gene and signtures of fibroblasts from normal and tumor


## Load dataset together

```{r load data, echo=F, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(SingleR) 
library(dplyr)
library(celldex) ## This is only available with R>=4.0, so load pregenerated data object hpca.ref instead if using R<4.0
library(RColorBrewer)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(hdf5r)
library(ggthemes)
library(xlsx)

setwd("/home/juliam/Documents/FernandoCalvo/scRNAseq_test/Signaures")

load("Breast.srat.combined.RData")
Breast.srat.combined <- srat.combined
rm(srat.combined)
load("Breast.srat.fibroblast.only.RData")
# load("/home/juliam/Documents/FernandoCalvo/scRNAseq_test/Cords_2023/BodenmillerGroup/CAFclassification-v0.1.1/BodenmillerGroup-CAFclassification-09b0205/scRNA-seq/Breast.srat.fibroblast.only.RData")
all.fibroblast <- FindNeighbors(object = all.fibroblast, dims = 1:25) %>% FindClusters(resolution = seq(from = 0.1, to = 2, by = 0.1))
all.fibroblast <- FindClusters(object = all.fibroblast, resolution = seq(from = 0.1, to = 1, by = 0.1))

all.fibroblast <- FindNeighbors(object = all.fibroblast, dims = 1:25, graph.name = "SCT_snn") %>% FindClusters(resolution = seq(from = 0.1, to = 2, by = 0.1), graph.name = "SCT_snn")
all.fibroblast <- FindClusters(object = all.fibroblast, resolution = seq(from = 0.1, to = 1, by = 0.1), graph.name = "SCT_snn")
Idents(all.fibroblast) <- all.fibroblast$SCT_snn_res.0.4
#add structural CAFs (sCAFs)/ activated CAFs (aCAFs) to labels
x <- c(0:11)
y <-c("mCAF", "iCAF", "vCAF", "Pericyte", "tpCAF", "hsp_tpCAF", "IDO_CAF", "mCAF", "apCAF",  "rCAF", "apCAF", "dCAF")
meta2_cluster <- as.data.frame(cbind(x,y))
colnames(meta2_cluster) <-c("Cluster","CAF_type_harmony")
meta2 <- meta2_cluster$CAF_type_harmony
meta2 <-as.character(meta2)
names(x = meta2) <- levels(x = all.fibroblast)
all.fibroblast <- RenameIdents(object = all.fibroblast, meta2)
#Save celltype information in metadata
all.fibroblast[["CAFtype"]] <- Idents(object = all.fibroblast)
# p<-DimPlot(object = all.fibroblast, reduction = 'umap',group.by = "CAFtype", label = F, pt.size = 1)+scale_color_tableau()
# plot(p)
Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only <- all.fibroblast
rm(all.fibroblast)

```


## 1. Image of whole tumor clusters with identification assigned


Breast

```{r whole clusters Breast}

Breast.srat.combined <- SetIdent(Breast.srat.combined, value = "seurat_clusters")
DimPlot(Breast.srat.combined, reduction = "umap", label = F, repel = TRUE)

Breast.srat.combined$cell_type[is.na(Breast.srat.combined$cell_type)] <- "NA"

Breast.srat.combined <- SetIdent(Breast.srat.combined, value = "cell_type")
DimPlot(Breast.srat.combined, label = F , repel = T, label.size = 3) + ggtitle('Tissue types metadata')

Breast.srat.combined <- SetIdent(Breast.srat.combined, value = "cell_type")
list_fibroblasts <- WhichCells(Breast.srat.combined, idents = c( "fibroblast"))
DimPlot(Breast.srat.combined, label=F, cells.highlight= list(list_fibroblasts), cols.highlight = c("darkblue"), cols= "grey")

```


## 2. Image of fibroblast clusters assigned

Breast

```{r fibroblasts clusters Breast}

Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only <- SetIdent(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only, value = "seurat_clusters")
DimPlot(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only, reduction = "umap", label = F, repel = TRUE)
DimPlot(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only, reduction = "umap", label = F, repel = TRUE, group.by = "CAFtype")+scale_color_tableau()

Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only$CAFtype_tpCAFjoined <- Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only$CAFtype
Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only$CAFtype_tpCAFjoined[Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only$CAFtype_tpCAFjoined == "hsp_tpCAF"] <- "tpCAF"
DimPlot(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only, reduction = "umap", label = F, repel = TRUE, group.by = "CAFtype_tpCAFjoined")+scale_color_tableau()

```


## 3. Map of expression in both types of data (whole tumor and fibroblasts) for indicated genes and signatures

Get signatures and genes

```{r}

my_signatures <- as.data.frame(read.xlsx("14_selecting signatures.xlsx", 1, header = F))

my_genes <- read.xlsx("14_selecting signatures.xlsx", 2, header = F)
my_genes <- c(unlist(my_genes))

```

Signatures expression in breast

```{r gene expression Breast}


DefaultAssay(Breast.srat.combined) <- "SCT"

Breast.table <- data.frame(
  cluster = Breast.srat.combined$seurat_clusters,
  cell_type = Breast.srat.combined$cell_type,
  tumour = "Tumour"
)

for (signature in 1:nrow(my_signatures)){
  signature_name <- my_signatures$X1[signature]
  signature_genes <- my_signatures[signature,-c(1,2)]
  marker_gene_list <- signature_genes[!is.na(signature_genes)]
  
  marker_gene_list <- list(unlist(marker_gene_list))
  
  Breast.srat.combined <- AddModuleScore(Breast.srat.combined, features = marker_gene_list, name = signature_name)
  print(FeaturePlot(Breast.srat.combined, features = paste0(signature_name,"1")))
  
  Breast.table[signature_name] <- Breast.srat.combined[[paste0(signature_name,"1")]]
  
}

for (gene_set in my_genes) {
  print(FeaturePlot(Breast.srat.combined, features = gene_set))
}

for (gene in my_genes){
  Breast.table[gene] <- FetchData(Breast.srat.combined, vars = gene)
}

```

Signature expression in breast fibroblasts

```{r gene expression Breast fibroblasts}

DefaultAssay(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only) <- "SCT"

Breast.fibroblasts.table <- data.frame(
  cluster = Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only$seurat_clusters,
  cell_type = Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only$CAFtype,
  cell_type_tpCAFjoined = Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only$CAFtype_tpCAFjoined,
  tumour = "Tumour"
)

for (signature in 1:nrow(my_signatures)){
  signature_name <- my_signatures$X1[signature]
  signature_genes <- my_signatures[signature,-c(1,2)]
  marker_gene_list <- signature_genes[!is.na(signature_genes)]
  
  marker_gene_list <- list(unlist(marker_gene_list))
  
  Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only <- AddModuleScore(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only, features = marker_gene_list, name = signature_name)
  print(FeaturePlot(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only, features = paste0(signature_name,"1")))
  
  Breast.fibroblasts.table[signature_name] <- Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only[[paste0(signature_name,"1")]]
  
}

for (gene_set in my_genes) {
  print(FeaturePlot(Breast.srat.combined, features = gene_set))
}

for (gene in my_genes){
  Breast.fibroblasts.table[gene] <- FetchData(Breast.srat.fibroblasts.only, vars = gene)
}

```


## 4. Expression matrix (average) so we can generate a heatmap or graph (gene and signatures)

I created the tables containing for every cell: normalised expression values per gene, signature value, cluster assigned, and celltype assigned.

Breast

```{r heatmap Breast}

write.csv(Breast.table, file="14_Breast.table.selecting_signatures.csv")

```

Breast fibroblasts

```{r heatmap Breast fibroblasts}

write.csv(Breast.fibroblasts.table, file="14_Breast.fibroblasts.table.selecting_signatures.csv")

```
